citations.title: Privacy Policy | Fluxco
excerpts: ## 4\. Cookies, retention, and security

We keep personal information only as long as needed for the purposes above, including active projects, warranty periods, and legal, tax, and recordkeeping requirements. We use reasonable administrative, technical, and physical safeguards, but no system is completely secure.
## 5\. Your choices and rights
Depending on where you live, including under the Texas Data Privacy and Security Act and similar state laws, you may have the right to:
* confirm whether we process your personal information and access it;
* correct inaccurate information;
* delete information you provided or we collected about you;
* get a portable copy of your information; and
* opt out of sale, targeted advertising, and profiling (we do not engage in these).

To make a request, email [privacy@fluxco.com](mailto:privacy@fluxco.com) or call (512) 859-3335. We will verify your identity and respond within 45 days, and we will not discriminate against you for exercising your rights. If we decline your request, you may appeal by replying to our decision; if your appeal is denied, you may contact the Texas Attorney General. You can unsubscribe from marketing emails at any time using the link in the email. To stop receiving text messages, reply **STOP** to any message; reply **HELP** for help. See the Text Messaging Program section of our [Terms of Service](https://fluxco.com/terms) for details.
## 6\. Other important information
**Children.** The Platform is for businesses and is not directed to anyone under 18. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children.

**International transfers.** We work with manufacturers worldwide, and some service providers process data outside your state or country, so personal information may be transferred to and processed in the United States and other countries, with safeguards appropriate to the data.
**Changes.** We will post updates here and revise the effective date. For material changes, we will provide additional notice, such as by email to account holders.
**Contact us.** Fluxco, Austin, Texas · [privacy@fluxco.com](mailto:privacy@fluxco.com) · (512) 859-3335

basis.reasoning: Fluxco’s privacy/legal page describes safeguards, privacy rights, transfers, and contact details but names none of SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, GDPR, or PCI DSS as a claimed certification.

citations.title: Careers at Fluxco
excerpts: [### Senior Transformer Design Engineer (Electrical & Mechanical Lead) Engineering Austin, TX Full-time Engineering We are looking for a rare "dual-threat" Design Engineer who excels in both Electromagnetic Analysis and Mechanical Design. You will not rely on separate departments for calculations and layouts; you will own the design holistically. The ideal candidate is a software power-user who utilizes advanced simulation and parametric CAD to create designs that are electrically efficient and optimized for manufacturing (DFM). View role & apply](https://fluxco.com/careers/senior-transformer-design-engineer) [### Full-Stack Software Engineer (AI-Native Generalist) Engineering Austin, TX Full-time Engineering We need one engineer who can own everything that runs on the web at Fluxco—the marketing site, the marketplace, the customer and supplier portals, and the internal tools that keep the business running. The catch: you don't ship like a 2019 engineer. You use Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and whatever comes next as core tools, not novelties. We expect a small AI-native team to out-ship a large traditional one, and we're building that way from day one. View role & apply](https://fluxco.com/careers/ai-native-full-stack-engineer) [### Head of Government Affairs (Federal & Regulatory Strategy) Policy Austin, TX Full-time Policy Modernizing America's grid isn't just an engineering problem—it's a policy problem. Tariffs, permitting, interconnection queues, transformer supply mandates, domestic content rules—these are the bottlenecks we can't engineer our way around. We need a public policy leader who can shape the regulatory and legislative environment so Fluxco (and the broader grid) can move faster. This role expects regular travel to Washington, D.C. View role & apply](https://fluxco.com/careers/head-of-government-affairs) [### Applications Engineer (Technical Quoting) Sales Austin, TX Full-time Sales Fluxco wins on the shortest lead time in the market—and that edge starts at the quote. We need someone who can take a customer's specs and turn them into a correct, buildable transformer configuration fast, so we can quote reliably and deliver on the promise. You'll be the technical engine behind every quote: reading one-line diagrams and nameplate data, sizing and selecting the equipment, and handing the team quote inputs they can trust. It's precise work—a wrong configuration is a wrong quote—and it's where Fluxco's speed is either real or it isn't. Get it right and you make the whole company faster. View role & apply](https://fluxco.com/careers/applications-engineer) [### Bid Coordinator (Utility & Public-Sector RFPs) Sales Austin, TX Full-time Sales Utilities and public agencies buy transformers through a maze of RFP portals, compliance forms, and approved-vendor lists—and they move on their own clock. We need someone to turn that maze into a clean, fast pipeline of bids Fluxco can win. You'll find every relevant transformer solicitation, read the fine print, and get a fully compliant bid out the door on time—every time. It's exacting work: in public bidding, one missing form or a late upload loses the deal no matter how good the price. Get it right and you open a channel most startups can't touch—the utilities and agencies rebuilding the grid. View role & apply](https://fluxco.com/careers/bid-coordinator) [### Supplier & OEM Manager (OEM Partnerships & Category Expansion) Supply Austin, TX Full-time Supply Fluxco runs on its OEM relationships. Every transformer we deliver comes from a network of manufacturers we have to know cold, trust, and keep moving fast. We need someone to own those relationships end to end and run them as a system, not a stack of one-off favors and inbox threads: be the single point of contact every OEM we work with already knows by name, keep existing partners productive, and bring new ones into the fold through a repeatable, structured process. Then push past transformers. The same customers who need our transformers need switchgear, breakers, and the rest of the gear that goes around them, and we want to supply it. You'll build the OEM network, and the playbook that runs it, that lets Fluxco say yes to more of what our customers ask for. View role & apply](https://fluxco.com/careers/supplier-oem-manager) [### Enterprise Account Executive (Energy & Infrastructure Developers) Sales Austin, TX Full-time Sales Battery storage, solar, and grid projects live and die on getting power equipment on site when the schedule says so—and the transformer is one of the longest poles in the tent, often quoted two years out. Fluxco turns a developer's spec into competitive bids from 150+ global OEMs in days, then manages the project end to end. One partner, full accountability, the shortest lead time in the market. Energy developers move fast, build in portfolios, and put the transformer squarely on the critical path to energization and interconnection. Win one project on schedule certainty and you're positioned to win the next five in their pipeline. This is a foundational seat. You'll sit across from developers, owners, and their EPCs as Fluxco's commercial lead in the segment, turn single project wins into standing equipment partnerships, and write the playbook the team scales with. You know how energy projects get financed, designed, and built—and where a missed delivery date turns one upside down. That knowledge is the seat. View role & apply](https://fluxco.com/careers/enterprise-account-executive-energy-infrastructure) [### Enterprise Account Executive (Commercial & Industrial (C&I)) Sales Austin, TX Full-time Sales Industrial plants and commercial builders need transformers for every new line, facility, and expansion—and they're stuck behind the same two-year+ lead times as everyone else. Fluxco turns a spec into competitive bids from 150+ global OEMs in days, then manages the project end to end. One partner, full accountability, the shortest lead time in the market. This segment is a channel sale. The engineer who writes the spec and the procurement lead who cuts the PO are rarely the same person, and the path between them runs through EPCs, general contractors, electrical contractors, consulting engineers, owner's reps, and distributors. Winning here means making each of them better off with Fluxco in the project. This is a foundational seat. You'll map the field, win the spec with the technical buyer, close the PO with procurement, and build the channel relationships that compound—then write the playbook the team scales with. You know how a project moves from spec to PO in this world, and who really decides at each step. That knowledge is the seat. View role & apply](https://fluxco.com/careers/enterprise-account-executive-commercial-industrial) [### Account Executive (Data Centers) Sales Austin, TX Full-time Sales Every AI data center runs on transformers, and the ones being built today are waiting the better part of two years for them. Fluxco turns a spec into competitive bids from 150+ global OEMs in days, then manages the project end to end. One partner, full accountability, the shortest lead time in the market. This is a full-cycle selling seat for someone early in a big career. You'll run the data center motion day to day—prospecting hard, qualifying fast, and moving deals with applications engineering behind every quote. Warm relationships in the hyperscaler and co-location world will make you productive from week one. You don't need to have closed eight-figure deals yet. You do need to be hungry, fast, coachable, and credible on the phone with people building the future of AI infrastructure. View role & apply](https://fluxco.com/careers/account-executive-data-centers)

excerpts: We use personal information to respond to inquiries and quote requests; build and review specifications and supplier quotes, including with AI-assisted tools; run the bidding, award, manufacturing, and delivery process; provide leasing, service, and warranty support; manage accounts; evaluate job applicants; send business communications you can opt out of, including text messages such as project updates, quote and order notifications, and service alerts if you opt in; protect the Platform against spam, fraud, and abuse; understand how the Platform is used so we can improve it; and meet legal obligations.
## 3\. How we share information
* **Manufacturers (OEMs) and suppliers:** when you post a project, we share the specification and the contact, site, and delivery details needed to bid, build, test, and ship your equipment.
* **Financing, logistics, and service partners:** when you request leasing, financing, shipping, installation, or warranty work.
* **Service providers:** companies that provide hosting, communications, analytics, security, AI, and business software for us, under contracts limiting their use of your data.
